Correlation of transcriptomic changes (neuropeptide/receptor genes) with phenotype changes across strains (CFA, CFM, sensorimotor, weight, lean prct)

Chunk 1: Load libraries, filter to animal/cluster pairs w/ > 30 cells (ensures adequate representation) and clean metadata
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(BPCells)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtext)

#a. identify strains we have in gene expression data (subset of larger number of strains in phenotype data)
animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>%
  dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>%
  dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)", "strain" = "Line.short",
                "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")
strains_present = unique(animal_metadata$strain)

#b. load full phenotype dataset (contains all behavioral variables including calorimetry)
full_pheno_dset = read_csv("../shared objs and code/calo_bx_data_clean_20260501.csv")
full_pheno_dset = full_pheno_dset %>% filter(Diet == "Chow")
full_pheno_dset$strain = full_pheno_dset$Line.short
full_pheno_dset <- full_pheno_dset %>%
  mutate(sleep_24hrtotal = sleep_24hrtotal / 3600)   # seconds -> hours

neuronal_assignments <- readRDS("../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
non_neuronal_assignments =  readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")
# Combine all assignments into a single dataframe
assignments_df <- data.frame(
  cluster = c(neuronal_assignments, non_neuronal_assignments),
  cell_id = c(names(neuronal_assignments), names(non_neuronal_assignments))
)

# Load the conversion file for internal cluster IDs to official names
df_internal_and_official_name <- read_csv("../shared objs and code/internal_to_official_name_conversions_neuronal.csv")

# Convert numeric neuronal cluster IDs to their official names
assignments_df <- assignments_df %>%
  mutate(cluster = case_when(
    cluster %in% df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id ~ df_internal_and_official_name$official_name[match(cluster, df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id)],
    .default = cluster
  ))


assignments_df$animal_id = sub(".*_([0-9]+)-.*", "\\1", assignments_df$cell_id)
assignments_df$animal_cluster = paste(assignments_df$animal_id, assignments_df$cluster, sep = "_")
#remove animal/clusters with less than 30 cells
assignments_df = assignments_df %>% group_by(animal_cluster) %>% add_tally(name = "cell_count")
assignments_df = assignments_df %>% filter(cell_count >= 30)
#add strain and sex
assignments_df$strain = animal_metadata$strain[match(assignments_df$animal_id, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
assignments_df$sex = animal_metadata$sex[match(assignments_df$animal_id, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
assignments_df$age = animal_metadata$age[match(assignments_df$animal_id, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
assignments_df$genotype = animal_metadata$genotype[match(assignments_df$animal_id, animal_metadata$animal_id)]

# Keep the full assignments_df ungrouped for downstream subsetting
assignments_df = assignments_df %>% ungroup()

#check - stop if > 1 per sex/strain/genotype/age (should max be 1)
stopifnot(all(
  (assignments_df %>%
     distinct(animal_id, sex, strain, genotype, age) %>%
     count(sex, strain, genotype, age) %>%
     pull(n)) == 1
))


#Load DE results, and filter to genes/clusters with significant 5x vs Ntg comparisons of either sex/age
de_results = qs2::qs_read("../shared objs and code/dreamlet_de_results_all_contrasts.qs2") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < .05) %>%
  filter(comparison %in% c("prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m","prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f","early_amyloid_contrast_m","early_amyloid_contrast_f"))

#get gene and cluster set to do pseudobulk on
gene_set = de_results$gene %>% unique
cluster_set = de_results$cluster %>% unique
```

Chunk 2: a) Screen clusters to determine if there's at least 8 strains with both Ntg and 5XFAD animals (do this per sex). b) Get pseudobulk log1p normalized expression values for the cluster/gene set, and associated metadata.
```{r}

#a) Screen clusters to determine if there's at least 8 strains with both Ntg and 5XFAD animals.
screen_clusters_for_age <- function(age_val,
                                    assignments_df,
                                    cluster_set,
                                    min_strains_per_cluster_sex = 8) {

  #ad = shorthand for assignments_df
  ad <- assignments_df %>%
    filter(age == age_val, cluster %in% cluster_set)

  ad_count <- ad %>%
    group_by(strain, sex, cluster) %>%
    summarize(n_animals = n_distinct(animal_id), .groups = "drop")

  # keep only strains where both 5xFAD and Ntg pass the 30-cell filter
  clusters_per_sex <- ad_count %>%
    filter(n_animals == 2) %>%
    group_by(cluster, sex) %>%
    summarize(n_strains = n_distinct(strain), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_strains >= min_strains_per_cluster_sex)
  
  clusters_per_sex = clusters_per_sex %>% mutate(cluster_sex = paste(cluster, sex, sep = "_"))
  ad = ad %>% mutate(cluster_sex = paste(cluster, sex, sep = "_"))
  
  #filter ad (assignments_df) to clusters (per sex) that satisfied the number of animals/cell count per animal threshold
  ad = ad %>% filter(cluster_sex %in% clusters_per_sex$cluster_sex)
  
  list(
    ad               = ad,
    clusters_per_sex = clusters_per_sex
  )
}

#b) Get pseudobulk log1p normalized expression values for the cluster/gene set, and associated metadata.
build_pseudobulk_for_age <- function(age_val, screen_result, animal_metadata, gene_set) {

  ad               <- screen_result$ad
  clusters_per_sex <- screen_result$clusters_per_sex

  # load, normalize, subset genes, pseudobulk
  ge <- open_matrix_dir("../shared objs and code/post_qc_decontx_counts/")[, ad$cell_id]
  ge <- log1p(multiply_cols(ge, 1 / Matrix::colSums(ge)) * 1e6)
  ge <- ge[rownames(ge) %in% gene_set, ]

  pb <- pseudobulk_matrix(ge, cell_groups = ad$animal_cluster, method = "mean", threads = 10L)

  meta <- data.frame(
    animal_cluster = colnames(pb),
    animal_id      = sub("_.*", "", colnames(pb)),
    cluster        = sub("^[0-9]+_", "", colnames(pb))
  ) %>%
    left_join(animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select(animal_id, strain, sex, genotype, age),
              by = "animal_id")

  message(sprintf("Age %d: %d samples, %d cluster/sex combos",
                  age_val, nrow(meta), nrow(clusters_per_sex)))

  list(clusters_per_sex = clusters_per_sex, pseudobulk_metadata = meta, pseudobulk_log_filtered = pb)
}

# Usage — screen first, then build
screen_6  <- screen_clusters_for_age(6,  assignments_df, cluster_set)
screen_14 <- screen_clusters_for_age(14, assignments_df, cluster_set)

pb_6  <- build_pseudobulk_for_age(6,  screen_6,  animal_metadata, gene_set)
pb_14 <- build_pseudobulk_for_age(14, screen_14, animal_metadata, gene_set)
```


This chunk was adapted from other code where I filtered genes based on num animals detected and expression level; since all are DEGs (as assessed by dreamlet), will not filter out any here)
```{r}
identify_eligible_genes <- function(clusters_per_sex,
                                    pseudobulk_metadata,
                                    pseudobulk_log_filtered,
                                    detect_threshold = 2,
                                    min_animals_detected = 5) {

  gene_eligibility_list = list()

  for (sex_val in c("Male", "Female")) {
    clusters_this_sex = clusters_per_sex %>%
      filter(sex == sex_val) %>%
      pull(cluster)

    for (clust in clusters_this_sex) {
      samples_ntg = pseudobulk_metadata %>%
        filter(cluster == clust, sex == sex_val, genotype == "Ntg") %>%
        pull(animal_cluster)
      samples_5xfad = pseudobulk_metadata %>%
        filter(cluster == clust, sex == sex_val, genotype == "5XFAD") %>%
        pull(animal_cluster)

      expr_ntg = pseudobulk_log_filtered[, samples_ntg, drop = FALSE]
      expr_5xfad = pseudobulk_log_filtered[, samples_5xfad, drop = FALSE]

      n_animals_expr_ntg = Matrix::rowSums(expr_ntg >= detect_threshold)
      n_animals_expr_5xfad = Matrix::rowSums(expr_5xfad >= detect_threshold)

      eligible_genes = rownames(pseudobulk_log_filtered)[
        (n_animals_expr_ntg >= min_animals_detected |
         n_animals_expr_5xfad >= min_animals_detected)
      ]

      if (length(eligible_genes) > 0) {
        gene_eligibility_list[[paste(clust, sex_val, sep = "_")]] = data.frame(
          gene = eligible_genes,
          cluster = clust,
          sex = sex_val
        )
      }
    }
  }
  bind_rows(gene_eligibility_list)
}

eligible_genes_6 = identify_eligible_genes(pb_6$clusters_per_sex,
                                           pb_6$pseudobulk_metadata,
                                           pb_6$pseudobulk_log_filtered,
                                          detect_threshold = 0,
                                          min_animals_detected =0)
eligible_genes_14 = identify_eligible_genes(pb_14$clusters_per_sex,
                                            pb_14$pseudobulk_metadata,
                                            pb_14$pseudobulk_log_filtered,
                                          detect_threshold = 0,
                                          min_animals_detected =0)

```

Produce the list of comparisons to test - the genes that are DEGs at 6 months for the 6 month transcriptome to 14 month phenotype comparisons, and the genes that are DEGs at 14 months for the 14 month transcriptome to 14 month phenotype comparisons. eligible_genes_6 - 6 month transcriptional; eligible_genes_14 - 14 month transcriptional
```{r}
# early amyloid DEGs -> 6 mo expression, prolonged amyloid DEGs -> 14 mo expression
sig_pairs_6 <- de_results %>%
  filter(comparison %in% c("early_amyloid_contrast_m", "early_amyloid_contrast_f")) %>%
  mutate(sex = if_else(comparison == "early_amyloid_contrast_m", "Male", "Female")) %>%
  distinct(gene, cluster, sex)

sig_pairs_14 <- de_results %>%
  filter(comparison %in% c("prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m", "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f")) %>%
  mutate(sex = if_else(comparison == "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m", "Male", "Female")) %>%
  distinct(gene, cluster, sex)

#filter the genes in eligible_genes_6 that are in sig_pairs_6 for a given gene/cluster/sex
eligible_genes_6  <- eligible_genes_6  %>% semi_join(sig_pairs_6,  by = c("gene", "cluster", "sex"))
eligible_genes_14 <- eligible_genes_14 %>% semi_join(sig_pairs_14, by = c("gene", "cluster", "sex"))
```


Get the difference in expression between 5xfad and Ntg animals for a given comparison. Comparison here is specific to a given gene, cluster, age, and sex; we get the difference in log normalized expression across strains for this group.
```{r}
#eligible_genes_df contains all the genes/clusters/sex groups to perform correlation analysis with
compute_expr_changes <- function(eligible_genes_df,
                                  pseudobulk_metadata,
                                  pseudobulk_log_filtered) {
  expr_changes_list = list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(eligible_genes_df))) {
    gene = eligible_genes_df$gene[i]
    clust = eligible_genes_df$cluster[i]
    sex_val = eligible_genes_df$sex[i]

    strains_available = pseudobulk_metadata %>%
      filter(cluster == clust, sex == sex_val) %>%
      pull(strain) %>% unique()

    for (strain_val in strains_available) {
      samples_ntg = pseudobulk_metadata %>%
        filter(cluster == clust, sex == sex_val,
               genotype == "Ntg", strain == strain_val) %>%
        pull(animal_cluster)
      samples_5xfad = pseudobulk_metadata %>%
        filter(cluster == clust, sex == sex_val,
               genotype == "5XFAD", strain == strain_val) %>%
        pull(animal_cluster)

      if (length(samples_ntg) == 1 & length(samples_5xfad) == 1) {#only 1 max per strain/sex/sample/age/genotype
        expr_ntg = pseudobulk_log_filtered[gene, samples_ntg, drop = FALSE]
        expr_5xfad = pseudobulk_log_filtered[gene, samples_5xfad, drop = FALSE]
        log_expr_change = expr_5xfad - expr_ntg

        expr_changes_list[[length(expr_changes_list) + 1]] = data.frame(
          gene = gene,
          cluster = clust,
          sex = sex_val,
          strain = strain_val,
          log_expr_change = log_expr_change %>% as.vector()
        )
      }
    }
  }
  bind_rows(expr_changes_list)
}

expr_changes_6mo = compute_expr_changes(eligible_genes_6,
                                        pb_6$pseudobulk_metadata,
                                        pb_6$pseudobulk_log_filtered)
expr_changes_14mo = compute_expr_changes(eligible_genes_14,
                                         pb_14$pseudobulk_metadata,
                                         pb_14$pseudobulk_log_filtered)

print(paste("6mo expr-change rows:", nrow(expr_changes_6mo)))
print(paste("14mo expr-change rows:", nrow(expr_changes_14mo)))
```


Get the difference in all phenotypes between 5xfad and Ntg animals for a given comparison, defined as in the above chunk. 
```{r}
compute_all_pheno_changes <- function(full_pheno_dset, phenotype_vars, age_val, strains_present) {

  pheno_age <- full_pheno_dset %>%
    filter(AgeGrp == age_val, strain %in% strains_present)

  agg <- pheno_age %>%
    group_by(strain, Sex, Genotype) %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(phenotype_vars), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
              .groups = "drop")

  changes <- agg %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(phenotype_vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Genotype, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(change = `5XFAD` - Ntg) %>%
    select(strain, sex = Sex, variable, change) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = change)

  # percent change only for Weight
  if ("Weight" %in% names(changes)) {
    # need original Ntg mean to compute pct
    ntg_weight <- agg %>%
      filter(Genotype == "Ntg") %>%
      select(strain, sex = Sex, ntg_weight = Weight)

    changes <- changes %>%
      left_join(ntg_weight, by = c("strain", "sex")) %>%
      mutate(Weight_pct = (Weight / ntg_weight) * 100) %>%
      select(-ntg_weight)
  }

  changes
}

phenotype_vars <- c("CFC.PS4", "Sensorimotor_composite", "Lean.prct","Fat.prct", "Weight","sleep_24hrtotal")

pheno_changes_14 <- compute_all_pheno_changes(full_pheno_dset, phenotype_vars, 14, strains_present)
```

Perform correlation between transcriptome change and phenotype change
```{r}
min_strains_for_cor <- 8
# Bundle each comparison set: eligible genes define what gets tested,
# paired with their expression changes and age info
comparison_sets <- list(
  list(eligible_genes = eligible_genes_6,  expr_changes = expr_changes_6mo,  expr_age = 6,  pheno_age = 14),
  list(eligible_genes = eligible_genes_14, expr_changes = expr_changes_14mo, expr_age = 14, pheno_age = 14)
)

all_cor <- list()

# Outer loop: each comparison set (early vs prolonged amyloid)
for (comp in comparison_sets) {

  # Gene/cluster/sex groups to test come directly from eligible genes
  groups <- comp$eligible_genes
  n_groups <- nrow(groups)
  
  cur_5x_vs_ntg_expr_change = comp$expr_changes
  
  # Inner loop: each phenotype variable
  for (pheno_var in phenotype_vars) {
    cor_col <- if (pheno_var == "Weight") "Weight_pct" else pheno_var

    # Attach phenotype change to expression changes for this variable
    expr_change <- cur_5x_vs_ntg_expr_change %>%
      left_join(pheno_changes_14 %>% select(strain, sex, pheno_val = all_of(cor_col)),
                by = c("strain", "sex")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(pheno_val), !is.na(log_expr_change))
    
    
    # Pre-allocate result vectors - should be 1 for each gene/phenotype comparison (so 1 for each row in groups)
    out_r       <- rep(NA_real_, n_groups)
    out_p       <- rep(NA_real_, n_groups)
    out_ci_low  <- rep(NA_real_, n_groups)
    out_ci_high <- rep(NA_real_, n_groups)
    out_n       <- integer(n_groups)
    out_plot_data <- vector("list", n_groups) #store plotting data
    
    for (i in seq_len(n_groups)) {
      # Subset to strains for this sex/cluster/gene group
      group_data <- expr_change %>%
        filter(sex == groups$sex[i], cluster == groups$cluster[i], gene == groups$gene[i])
      out_plot_data[[i]] = group_data
      out_n[i] <- n_distinct(group_data$strain)
      
      
      # Check if min number of strains for both expr and phenotype for this comparison
      if (out_n[i] < min_strains_for_cor) next

      x <- group_data$log_expr_change  # transcriptomic change (5XFAD - Ntg)
      y <- group_data$pheno_val        # phenotype change (5XFAD - Ntg)

      # Skip if either variable has zero variance (cor undefined)
      if (var(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 || var(y, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) next

      res <- cor.test(x, y, method = "pearson")
      out_r[i]       <- unname(res$estimate)
      out_p[i]       <- res$p.value
      out_ci_low[i]  <- res$conf.int[1]
      out_ci_high[i] <- res$conf.int[2]
    }

    # Assemble results, FDR-correct within each sex/cluster
    key <- paste0(pheno_var, "_pheno", comp$pheno_age, "mo_expr", comp$expr_age, "mo")
    
    #compile results
    results_df = groups %>%
      mutate(n_strains = out_n, r_value = out_r, ci_low = out_ci_low,
             ci_high = out_ci_high, p.value = out_p,
             phenotype = pheno_var, pheno_age = comp$pheno_age, expr_age = comp$expr_age, plotting_data = out_plot_data)
    
    all_cor[[key]] <-  results_df

  }
}

full_results_df = bind_rows(all_cor)

full_results_df = full_results_df %>% 
      filter(!is.na(r_value)) %>%
      group_by(sex, cluster,pheno_age,expr_age,phenotype) %>%
      mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
      ungroup()


write_csv(full_results_df, "all_transcriptome_phenome_associations_DEGs.csv")
# Hits passing FDR threshold
fdr_passed <- full_results_df %>% filter(fdr < .1)
```

pheno_label <- function(pheno_var) {
  switch(pheno_var,
    "Weight"                 = "Weight % Change",
    "Lean.prct"              = "Change in Lean Mass Percent",
    "CFC.PS4"                = "Change in CFA",
    "Sensorimotor_composite" = "Change in Sensorimotor",
    "sleep_24hrtotal"        = "Change in hours slept",
    paste0("Change in ", pheno_var)
  )
}


selected_rows = selected_rows %>% arrange(phenotype)
plots <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(selected_rows))) {
  
  
  row <- selected_rows[i, ]
  
  y_axis_pheno_label <- pheno_label(row$phenotype)

  df_plot <- selected_rows$plotting_data[[i]] %>%
    filter(!is.na(log_expr_change)) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(pheno_val))

  xlab = paste0("*", row$gene, "* expression change<br>(5XFAD - Ntg ", row$expr_age, " mo)")
    
  ylab = paste0(y_axis_pheno_label, " (5XFAD - Ntg ", row$pheno_age, " mo)")
  
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = log_expr_change, y = pheno_val, label = strain)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", alpha = .3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", alpha = .3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = F,
                color = "#FBAD35", alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_point(aes(color = strain),size = 7) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = -Inf,
             label = sprintf("r = %.2f\nFDR = %s",
                             row$r_value, signif(row$fdr, 2)),
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.3, size = 7, fontface = "bold") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
      scale_color_manual(name = "Strain", values = color_mapping_strains_to_colors) +
    theme(
          axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.title.x = element_markdown(face = "bold"))+
      guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
    labs(subtitle = paste0(row$cluster, " | ", row$sex),
         x = xlab,
         y = ylab)
  plots[[length(plots) + 1]] <- p
}
